MV KESTREL MOOR - Qingdao, Qingdao Bulk Terminal

Please keep us informed of the vessel's ETA.

Best regards,
Operations desk
Qingdao Port Agency

result.result:
The berth confirmation from the Qingdao Port Agency is firm ("the terminal has confirmed KESTREL MOOR's berth for 29 Jan 1200 UTC"), and since this is significantly later than the current ETA of 27 Jan 00:00 UTC, a speed reduction is advisable.

The voyage optimisation service's simulated figures suggest reducing the speed to 7.4 kn, which would result in an arrival at 29 Jan 10:07 UTC, saving 58 hours at anchor and 109.4 tonnes of VLSFO.

The operator should decide whether to order this reduced speed. If agreed, the following steps would follow:
(a) a speed instruction to the Master with the advised speed (7.4 kn) and arrival (29 Jan 10:07 UTC), noting that his judgement for the safety of the ship in the weather ahead comes first;
(b) an ETA notice to the agent and receiver, as indicated by the check_notices tool, with the new ETA of 29 Jan 10:07 UTC;
(c) a voyage management system entry for the Qingdao port call ETA.

I recommend that nothing be sent until the operator answers.

detail.text:

The operator should decide whether to order this reduced speed. If agreed, the following steps would follow:
(a) a speed instruction to the Master with the advised speed (7.4 kn) and arrival (29 Jan 10:07 UTC), noting that his judgement for the safety of the ship in the weather ahead comes first;
(b) an ETA notice to the agent and receiver, as indicated by the check_notices tool, with the new ETA of 29 Jan 10:07 UTC;
(c) a voyage management system entry for the Qingdao port call ETA.

I recommend that nothing be sent until the operator answers.
